description.value: Twisted Indian is a fast-casual Indian fusion chain serving halal rice bowls, wraps, salads, and naan wraps with customizable proteins and toppings. The Kingsway location is one of several BC outposts of a growing franchise with roots in Ontario, making it a convenient refuel stop along a busy Vancouver corridor. The menu is designed to accommodate a wide range of diets, with clearly labeled vegan, gluten-free, and halal items.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating fast-food restaurant confirmed on the business's own website with matching address and phone. A useful refuel stop for cyclists on the Kingsway corridor.
